clay_herbalist.name: Clay Herbalist
greetings: The roots tell me where you have walked. Your boots are less discreet.
A bruised leaf still has a useful smell. Let me see your finds.
clay_herbalist.work: I sort herbs for the local kitchens. I buy clean gathered materials and keep enough coins for the next traveler.

moss_listener.name: Moss Listener
greetings: Quiet. I am trying to hear which branch the wind has misplaced.
The forest is full of paths. Some of them are only for beetles.
moss_listener.work: I inspect trail markers and note the old stonework near these paths. I would rather mend a sign than rescue another impatient explorer.

lantern_peddler.name: Lantern Peddler
greetings: A little light, a little trade. That is how a long road is made.
The lamps are bright. The prices fit on a small sign.
lantern_peddler.work: I carry ordinary supplies between safe stops. I buy finds from travelers, keep a finite purse, and leave the creature grounds alone.

scrap_fencer.name: Scrap Fencer
greetings: The left knee is newer than the rest of me. It is very proud of this.
A blade should be cared for. So should the hand that holds it.
scrap_fencer.work: I inspect old repairs along these paths. I once stood watch at a gate whose hinges have outlived its kingdom. These days I prefer a quiet walk.
